plans.idea: Optical-centre poster: one tall, full-width text block sitting just above centre so the headline wraps to four large lines ('Sparkle / slowly. Sip / at sunset.') with the tracked subline close underneath. The lower third stays open for the decorative circle, which keeps the original's calm, centred feel.

Top-anchored editorial stack: a big headline block runs down from the top margin so the eye starts on 'Sparkle slowly.' and moves straight down to the brand line. The bottom half is left to the circle as a deliberate counterweight, the 'sunset' shape.

Bottom-weighted 'sunset' composition: the text sits in the lower half, right above where the circle rises, so the headline reads as the horizon. The open dark sky above gives the large type breathing room on this skyscraper shape.
